HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the House and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
